purpose: Prove the new j8_frontier --bootstrap-seed flag leaves the default output byte-identical, and that the flag re-seeds the bootstrap end to end.
method: The committed (HEAD) j8_frontier.py, loaded from git show HEAD and executed at its real path, and the working-tree j8_frontier.py (with the flag, default = omitted) were run concurrently in the same PBS job on the same inputs; outputs written to a temp directory, never over the committed report.
worktree_vs_committed_note: head_vs_worktree_byte_identical = true shows the flag's default path changes nothing: the committed and working-tree j8_frontier.py produce the same bytes in the same environment. The two keys that differ from the committed report (oracle_semantics, oracle_semantics_citation; 4 lines of the diff) are citation strings holding line numbers in src/sidekick/runner.py and src/sidekick/systems/loop.py, which carry uncommitted edits by other workers; no numeric field differs.
